ABOUT THE ARCHIVE

A closer look at the game.

This explorer contains all five decoded cache tables: 701 hero records, 2,670 battle actions, 10,157 monsters, 4,073 NPCs, and 170,387 English text entries. Variants count as separate records.

Search checks every field, including nested data. Numeric filters compare stored values. Open a record to inspect every field and nested list, or switch to its original JSON.

What is not included

The XP table (exps2), other undecoded tables, and 6,344 encrypted scripts remain unavailable. No level-to-XP requirements have been inferred.

Source: decoded caches from the supplied com.kakaogames.gdtskr folder. The cache date and client version are not verified. The separately inspected APK uses a different package name and is not a data source for these tables.
